claims.claim: Also deals on all kinds of cars spare parts
claims.evidence: Photos show only one alternator; nothing about the seller's other inventory is visible.
Country of origin and import status cannot be determined from photos of the alternator.

risks.risk: Alternator may not function or has never been tested
risks.proof: Video of the alternator spinning with a multimeter showing correct voltage output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working / as-is with no electrical guarantee.

risks.proof: Clear photo of any date code, part number, or label, plus service history if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an aged, high-mileage unit.

risks.risk: Compatibility with buyer's vehicle is unknown
risks.proof: Legible part number photo and confirmation of fitment for a specific make and model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as fitment-unknown; may not fit the buyer's car.

risks.risk: Internal bearings and brushes may be worn
risks.proof: Operation video with audio, or an inspection report after opening the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing internal rebuild or bearing replacement.

risks.proof: Written warranty or return policy from the seller.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as final sale with no recourse if it fails.

proof_requests: Video of alternator being tested with voltage output reading
Close-up photo of label or part number and any date code
Confirmation of compatible vehicle make and model
Video with audio of alternator running to check for noise
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used car alternator, so a worst-case price is possible even though all seller claims are unproven; proof of testing, fitment, and condition would raise the value.
